placementRules.notes: Session 49: right-edge master, extracted and style-corrected from a two-counter source composite (left reddish counter discarded, not used). Measured, not copied from the vada-pav family: visualBounds/footprint/pivot below are this asset's own alpha-inspected geometry. minSpacing and placementWeight stay 0 for the same reason as the vada-pav records: no procedural pool exists yet, this record must not enter a runtime pool on its own.

notes: Session 49: right-hand teal shallow-awning chai counter, extracted from a two-counter source composite delivered by the PM (source file kept outside the repo at ~/Documents/Working images/chai_counter_composite.png, 1536x1024 RGBA, NOT committed as a runtime asset — see CHANGELOG for provenance). The two counters were separated by connected-component analysis on the composite's alpha channel: left (reddish) component bbox x[70,750], right (teal, USED) component bbox x[812,1445], a clean 62px transparent gap between them, zero pixel overlap. Extraction: isolated the right component only (discarded 3,836 stray dust px belonging to neither large component), cropped to a 48px-padded working canvas. Alpha cleanup (same deterministic method as Session 48, applied here first before the style pass since this binary needed it): Gaussian-smoothed alpha (sigma=1.5) -> alpha>=200 core -> 4px Euclidean dilation (real AA fringe) -> zero everything else. This removed a baked ground-contact shadow (soft low-alpha band under the counter, mean alpha 22-125, tapering to zero over ~16 rows, near-black RGB ~[40,41,33] - consistent with the Session 48 defect family) and reduced sub-alpha-8 dust from 942 to 347, all of which are contiguous antialiasing fringe on the single silhouette component (0 disconnected/stray after cleanup; connected-component count was 1 both before and after). Canvas then trimmed to a tight 48px-padded production crop: 699x709, down from the initial 730x712 working crop. Style correction: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering(sp=18, sr=45) + light bilateral(d=5, sigmaColor=40, sigmaSpace=40) + PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06 - identical parameters to the shipped vada-pav v002 family, no per-asset retuning needed. Measured effect (within the alpha>=8 silhouette mask): Laplacian-std texture 83.2->48.4 (-42%), greyscale contrast std 54.4->40.8 (-25%), mean HSV saturation 69.2->41.4 (-40%). Geometry bit-identical before/after the style pass (alpha>=32 bbox (48,48)-(650,658) both times) - only alpha/RGB moved, confirming the style pass never touched crop or scale. Orientation verified, not assumed: kettle spout points left toward the jars/tins (service side), the counter's box recedes/narrows toward the right (structural depth), side cloth and side storage box sit left-of-centre - matches the required right-edge convention (service faces road-left, structure extends city-right) with no mirroring applied or needed. Footprint x0=83 is a deliberately conservative (safe-side) measurement: the ground-contact band scan (y 580-658, alpha>=200) picks up the corner where the side cloth's lower drape is adjacent to the front-left foot, and the two could not be cleanly separated by alpha alone at this ambiguity margin (~15px). Using the more-left value is the conservative choice for the footprintClear road-safety gate (requires MORE clearance, never less) - flagged here rather than silently resolved. Source-composite provenance: PAB source file 'chai_counter_composite.png', two counters (left reddish, right teal), only the right teal counter used per this session's brief; the left reddish counter was not extracted and has no corresponding asset in this repo. Status is 'review' (not 'approved'), pending PM sign-off on the style-correction result and a decision on Test B (mixed placement with the vada-pav cart), which was explicitly out of scope for this session.
